source.authority: candidate-only; no physical provider admission, RCL promotion, release promotion or main-branch mutation

change.upstreamTerrainOwner: Large World Runtime terrain sampling and grid mesh
change.queryContract: sphere origin/direction/maxDistance -> bounded heightfield authored-triangle sweep hit with fixed-point point and normal
change.algorithm: bounded projected XZ cell window plus deterministic face/edge/vertex sphere-vs-triangle intersection, returning the earliest fixed-point hit

positiveEvidence: A fixed-point sphere sweep against flat authored terrain returns the first face contact distance, point and upward normal.
A sphere sweep starting outside the authored heightfield XZ boundary resolves the triangle edge/vertex feature rather than overreaching through the footprint support approximation.
Unsupported box shape casts fail closed with SPATIAL_SHAPE_CAST_UNSUPPORTED rather than silently using an AABB approximation.
A lowered Large World terrain chunk reaches the same authored-triangle sphere sweep path and returns a rooted terrain fixture hit.
negativeEvidence: The implementation is bounded to unrotated static or fixed-rotation kinematic heightfields and a maximum projected sweep window of 4096 cells.

Only sphere-vs-triangle sweeps are exact in this candidate; upright capsule remains the earlier sampled support probe, while arbitrary capsule rotation, box/convex terrain sweeps and complete contact manifolds remain open.
The sweep is a query path only: it does not change authoritative world state, integrate contacts, or replace the existing single-support collision solver.
No dynamic terrain, physical device, target GPU frame-rate, Android, external network or production terrain deployment evidence exists.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS by source, package tests or CPU reference execution alone.
